description: What anyone can learn about one ERC-8004 agent on Robinhood Chain from the chain alone, by its agent id: a privacy grade (A to F), a score out of 100 and each leak found, with its proof and a tip. It reads whether payments land on the owner's own account, whether the owner first funded the payment address or sent to it directly (an on-chain transfer, never proof of who owns what), other agents the owner registered, other agents sharing the payment address, how many wallets paid its x402 payTo in 30 days, and the payment wallet's own wallet-privacy leaks (funding trail, linked wallets, holdings, activity hours). What helps (a stealth address registered under ERC-6538, funding from a shielded pool) is listed apart. Every part not read is named, never counted as no leak. The grade measures what anyone can see, not whether the agent is good or bad. Robinhood Chain only.

agent_id.description: The agent id: its ERC-8004 token id in the Robinhood Chain identity registry, a whole number from 0 to 1000000000 (for example 20030)
